AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-PROVE.title: Prove
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-PROVE.description:
Mark a card as genuine, to know that it's not disguised in [gold]Foresight[/gold].
Does not work on [gold]Obscured[/gold] cards.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-CERTIFY.title: Certify
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-CERTIFY.description:
Mark a card as genuine, to know that it's not disguised in [gold]Foresight[/gold].
Works on [gold]Obscured[/gold] cards, preventing their disguise.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-REWRITE.title: Rewrite
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-REWRITE.description: Choose any number of cards in [gold]Foresight[/gold] to discard.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-OBSCURE.title: Obscure
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-FORESEEN.title: Foreseen
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-FORESEEN.description:
If this card is revealed by [gold]Foresight[/gold], the following effect takes place.
Can only trigger once before leaving the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-DEFY.title: Defy
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-DEFY.description: If this card is discarded before the end of your turn, the following effect takes place.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-DRAWN.title: Drawn
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-DRAWN.description: Whenever you draw this card, the following effect takes place.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-HELD.title: Held
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-HELD.description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], the following effect takes place.
